$comment: This is NOT a package.json and MUST NOT be installed from — it is the approved technology profile for UI Studio's frontend, cross-checked against ui/package.json and ui/package-lock.json by scripts/verify_ui_studio_structure.py. Phase 1 activation (claude/ui-activation-phase-1) pinned every entry below to a real, installed version resolved from the npm registry, or explicitly marked NOT_INSTALLED_PHASE_1 with a reason. No version here was guessed.

dependencies.name: typescript
dependencies.note: devDependency in package.json (build-time only). Pinned below typescript-eslint's supported ceiling (<6.1.0) rather than the newer TypeScript 7 line — see typescript-eslint note below.

dependencies.name: @tauri-apps/api
dependencies.note: No source file imports @tauri-apps/api; Tauri activation/bundling is explicitly out of scope for Phase 1.

dependencies.name: @deck.gl/react
dependencies.note: src/components/maps/DeckOverlay.tsx imports this directly. The 'deck.gl' meta-package itself is not installed — nothing imports it; @deck.gl/react + @deck.gl/layers are the same 9.3.7 release train.

dependencies.name: @deck.gl/core
dependencies.note: Required peer of @deck.gl/react and @deck.gl/layers (not optional); not imported directly.

dependencies.name: @deck.gl/widgets
dependencies.note: Required peer of @deck.gl/react (not optional); not imported directly.

dependencies.name: @luma.gl/core
dependencies.note: Required peer of @deck.gl/layers (not optional); not imported directly.

dependencies.name: @luma.gl/engine
dependencies.note: Required peer of @deck.gl/layers (not optional); not imported directly.

dependencies.name: @loaders.gl/core
dependencies.note: Required peer of @deck.gl/layers (not optional); not imported directly.

dependencies.name: @react-three/fiber
dependencies.note: Peer range restricts react to >=19 <19.3; react is pinned to 19.2.8 to satisfy it.

devDependencies.name: @tailwindcss/vite
devDependencies.note: Added beyond the original approved list: the official Vite plugin required to wire the already-approved tailwindcss dependency into the v4 CSS-first pipeline (Tailwind v4 has no @tailwind directives to fall back to).

devDependencies.name: @tauri-apps/cli
devDependencies.note: Tauri activation/bundling is explicitly out of scope for Phase 1; src-tauri/ is untouched.

devDependencies.name: jsdom
devDependencies.note: Added beyond the original approved list: vitest.config.ts sets environment: "jsdom", which vitest does not bundle.

devDependencies.name: @storybook/react
devDependencies.note: Added beyond the original approved list: stories/Button.stories.tsx imports Meta/StoryObj types from "@storybook/react" directly, separate from the @storybook/react-vite framework package.

devDependencies.name: typescript-eslint
devDependencies.note: Added beyond the original approved list: required to lint TypeScript with ESLint's flat config. Its peerDependency caps typescript at <6.1.0 — the reason TypeScript is pinned to 6.0.3 rather than the newer 7.x line; no released typescript-eslint yet supports TypeScript 7.

devDependencies.name: @eslint/js
devDependencies.note: Added beyond the original approved list: base recommended flat config typescript-eslint composes with.

devDependencies.name: eslint-plugin-react-hooks
devDependencies.note: Added beyond the original approved list: rules-of-hooks linting for the hooks used throughout src/.

devDependencies.name: eslint-plugin-react-refresh
devDependencies.note: Added beyond the original approved list: pairs with @vitejs/plugin-react's Fast Refresh.

devDependencies.name: globals
devDependencies.note: Added beyond the original approved list: browser/node global identifiers for the flat ESLint config.

devDependencies.name: @types/react
devDependencies.note: Added beyond the original approved list: React 19 ships no bundled types.

devDependencies.name: @types/react-dom
devDependencies.note: Added beyond the original approved list: React DOM 19 ships no bundled types.
